stories.headline: You can now stream PS Plus games to Steam Deck without owning a PS5 - and without buying a PS Portal
stories.summary: A new cloud-streaming app, Asobi: Remote Play, allows players to stream PlayStation games to their Steam Deck and Steam Machine without a PS5. The app has implemented PlayStation Plus cloud streaming, enabling users to play supported games from the PS Plus catalog and select digital PS5 games they own. PS Plus Premium members can also stream other purchased titles. The app leverages Remote Play, which normally requires a PlayStation console, to stream games directly to other devices. With this update, users can access PS5 games on their Steam Deck or Steam Machine without needing a PS5 or buying a PS Portal. The app is currently in playtest, and setting it up requires a few steps, but it allows for seamless streaming of PlayStation games on non-PlayStation devices. This development expands gaming options for Steam Deck and Steam Machine users.

stories.headline: Apple might finally bring the ceramic Apple Watch back, and I've been waiting for it
stories.summary: Apple may reintroduce the ceramic Apple Watch, a premium material option that was discontinued in 2020. The ceramic model was part of the Apple Watch Edition lineup, which started at $1,249. Previously, Apple only released a white ceramic Apple Watch Series 5, but rumors suggest a potential black ceramic model may have been considered. The ceramic Apple Watch was the most premium material option available, and its absence has been notable for fans of the material. The potential return of the ceramic Apple Watch comes as Apple continues to expand its wearable offerings, including the recent release of the Apple Watch Ultra 2. If reintroduced, the ceramic model would likely be a high-end option, appealing to those seeking a luxurious and durable smartwatch.

stories.headline: What Project Motor Racing is working on next
stories.summary: Project Motor Racing has undergone significant updates, including a major handling overhaul for the GT3 and GT4 classes in Update 2.1. The game also features native triple screen support for PC drivers in alpha form and a promising VR experience. Recently, Kevin Boland was appointed as the new CEO of Project Motor Racing. In an interview, Boland and CCO Aristotelis Vasilakos discussed the game's future developments. Project Motor Racing is set to be available on PC through Steam on November 25th. The game's community can join discussions on the official gameplay video on the OC3D Forums. With the new leadership and ongoing updates, Project Motor Racing continues to evolve and improve, offering enhanced gameplay experiences for players. The latest updates and future plans indicate a commitment to delivering a high-quality racing game.

stories.headline: WinZir expands digital entertainment with Jili-powered e-bingo launch
stories.summary: WinZir, a PAGCOR-licensed sportsbook and gaming operator, has expanded its digital entertainment offerings with the launch of Jili-powered e-bingo. This new addition is part of WinZir's efforts to enhance its online gaming platform, which also includes a sportsbook and casino. The company, owned by Sandbox Entertainment Corp., operates as a local Philippine Inland Gaming Operator (PIGO). WinZir's latest move aims to provide a more diverse and engaging experience for its users. The launch of e-bingo follows the company's recent website upgrade, which features a smoother interface, easier betting, and more options. With this expansion, WinZir continues to solidify its position in the Philippine online gaming market, offering a range of entertainment options to its users. The company is licensed by the Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR), ensuring a secure and regulated gaming environment.

stories.headline: Yorkshire deaf golfers represent England at World Championships
stories.summary: Three golfers from Yorkshire, Brian Robinson, Charlotte Dixon, and Donna Serridge-Cross, are part of England's 24-player squad competing in the World Deaf Golf Championships in Sweden. The championships provide a platform for deaf athletes to showcase their skills and achievements. England Deaf Golf selected the squad through a rigorous process, choosing from a large number of applicants. The team's participation in the World Deaf Golf Championships aims to promote ambition, community, and the capabilities of deaf athletes. The event is an opportunity for the golfers to compete on a global stage, representing England and the deaf community. The World Deaf Golf Championships will take place in Sweden, with the English squad looking to make a strong impression and bring pride to their nation and community.

stories.headline: Dimitris Giannakopoulos admits he has “one and a half foot in, half foot out” at Panathinaikos
stories.summary: Dimitris Giannakopoulos, president and CEO of Vianex and owner of Panathinaikos, has expressed uncertainty about his future with the Greek club. He stated that he has "one and a half foot in, half foot out" at Panathinaikos, leaving the door open for a possible departure. Giannakopoulos' comments come after a tumultuous season for the team, which has struggled to perform consistently. The owner had previously criticized the players, calling for more effort, and has also spoken about the challenges facing the club. Despite this, Panathinaikos is heading to the championship series of Greece's Stoiximan GBL Playoffs 2026. Giannakopoulos' admission has sparked speculation about his long-term involvement with the club, and his potential exit could have significant implications for Panathinaikos' future. The owner's comments have added to the uncertainty surrounding the team's leadership and direction.

stories.headline: Hibernian stun Rangers at Ibrox while O’Neill misses Høgh treble in Celtic win
stories.summary: Hibernian secured a stunning 2-1 win over Rangers at Ibrox Stadium in a Premiership match. The victory came in stoppage time, dealing a significant blow to Rangers manager Derek McInnes on his home debut. Striker Youssef Chermiti was carried off the pitch on a stretcher during the game. Meanwhile, in another match, Celtic won with a notable performance from Høgh, who scored a treble, although manager Martin O'Neill was absent due to an operation. O'Neill's absence did not hinder Celtic's success, as they emerged victorious. The results mark significant developments in the Premiership, with Hibernian's win at Ibrox being a major upset and Celtic's victory showcasing their strength under O'Neill's guidance, despite his temporary absence.

stories.headline: Eastbourne penny farthing hill climb champion crowned
stories.summary: A penny farthing racer has won the Beachy Head time trial for the second consecutive year. The event, held in East Sussex, saw 40 participants compete in a three-mile course from Eastbourne to the top of Beachy Head cliff on public roads. The 2025 Beachy Head Penny Farthing Hill Climb World Championship attracted 39 riders from the UK, Europe, and the Americas. This annual hill climb is the only cycling event of its kind in the world specifically for penny farthings. The unique competition brings together riders from around the globe to test their skills and endurance on the challenging course. The winner's achievement marks a notable milestone in the event's history, solidifying their position as a top competitor in the niche sport of penny farthing racing.
